name: אֲרָרָט
summary: Ararat names a region on whose mountains the ark came to rest. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The plural construct הָרֵי followed by אֲרָרָט gives “the mountains of Ararat.”

note: Moved from the former word entry `2earaaraa6`. The old root key אררט recorded the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is uncertain.
